{{Quote|The lepusa were first discovered on the planet Freliq over two decades ago.|Holobrochure for the Tagge Holographic Museum of Chandrila|<ref name="Creatures" />}}
'''Freliq''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]]. It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[lepusa]], a type of [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] burrowing [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] who were able to manufacture crude tools. At some point, the [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] who had introduced off-world [[Grain/Legends|grain]] crops on Freliq first encountered the lepusa, whose [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] nature and burrowing habits soon made them little more than vermin in the farmers' eyes. The local [[Farm/Legends|farm]] manager [[Yasil Senerio]] once had an encounter with a lepusa which saved their [[Jullisa Senerio|daughter]], and Senerio recounted the incident to the [[Imperial Investigation Committee on Lepusan Intelligence]].

==Description==
{{Quote|It was a big white male, nearly a meter tall. It must have had a burrow entrance somewhere on the hillside.|Yasil Senerio, from a sworn testimony to the Imperial Investigation Committee on Lepusan Intelligence on a lepusa they at one point encountered|<ref name="Beholder" />}}
Freliq was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Creatures" /> located in the [[Freliq system/Legends|Freliq system]], a part of the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet's terrain featured hills, and among the [[Plant/Legends|plants]] that grew there were [[Flower/Legends|flowers]] and a type of subterranean [[Vine/Legends|vine]]<ref name="Beholder" /> as well as off-world [[Grain/Legends|grain]] crops introduced by the local [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]]. Freliq's wildlife included [[grub]]s and the [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]], [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] burrowing<ref name="Creatures" /> [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]]<ref name="CSWE lepusa">{{CSWECite|II|251|lepusa}}</ref> known as the [[lepusa]].<ref name="Creatures" />

==History==
===Relations with farmers===
{{Quote|As natural herbivores that live off roots and grubs, lepusa have found newly introduced off-world grains to be a particular delicacy. Few farmers, however, are willing to share their plantings with their new neighbors.|Holobrochure for the Tagge Holographic Museum of Chandrila|<ref name="Creatures" />}}
Farmers on Freliq at some point encountered the local lepusa creatures, and the latter immediately became the center of a planet-wide controversy. The unchecked population growth of the burrowing creatures led to their labyrinthine subterranean tunnels adversely affecting the soil productivity of the farmers' [[Farm/Legends|land properties]], and approximately twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] since the first contact, the lepusa migrations began to threaten the local farming operations since the creatures took a liking to the imported off-world grain crops.<ref name="Creatures" />

Further adding to the controversy on Freliq were later-year studies that reported that the lepusa were capable of using self-created rudimentary tools, with some [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologists]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] claiming that the creatures had a crude social order. The findings were subsequently fiercely contested by the planet's farmers, who feared suffering economic losses if the lepusa became classified as a protected [[Species/Legends|species]]. Eventually, a temporary injunction was issued that prohibited the farmers from [[Death/Legends|killing]] the lepusa as pests.<ref name="Creatures" />

===An unexpected help===
{{Quote|<nowiki />''[&hellip;]'' for me, seeing is believing. I see my little girl here in this courtroom today thanks to a so-called 'dumb animal.' That's all the proof I need.|Yasil Senerio, from a sworn testimony to the Imperial Investigation Committee on Lepusan Intelligence|<ref name="Beholder" />}}
At one point, [[Jullisa Senerio|Jullisa]], the [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] of the Freliq farm manager [[Yasil Senerio]], visited an abandoned [[Train/Legends|rail track]] running across [[Veriss Creek]]. She eventually found herself dangling from a broken tie of the bridge, with her cries for help attracting her [[Parent/Legends|father]] and [[Lox (farmer)|Lox]], who were both nearby at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. A lepusa, who Senerio later speculated must have had a burrow located nearby, also arrived at the track and, after seemingly appraising the situation, dug up an underground vine that it then used to pull Jullisa up to safety.<ref name="Beholder" />

Senerio later recounted the experience on Freliq as part of a sworn testimony to the [[Imperial Investigation Committee on Lepusan Intelligence]].<ref name="Beholder" /> More than two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] following the first discovery of the lepusa, Freliq was also mentioned in an entry of a [[Holo-brochure|holobrochure]] for the [[Tagge Holographic Museum]] of<ref name="Creatures" /> the planet<ref name="CSWE Chandrila">{{CSWECite|I|119|Chandrila}}</ref> [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] dedicated to the creatures.<ref name="Creatures" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|In fact, many lepusa are killed as vermin by angry planters.|Holobrochure for the Tagge Holographic Museum of Chandrila|<ref name="Creatures" />}}
Freliq was home to a population of farmers, many of whom resented the local lepusa creatures feeding upon their grain crops and as a result often killed them as vermin until the act was temporarily outlawed.<ref name="Creatures" /> Among the farmers of Freliq were Lox and Yasil Senerio with the latter's daughter, Jullisa. Senerio, however, had a more positive attitude toward the lepusa.<ref name="Beholder" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|I'd warned Jullisa to stay away from the abandoned rail line running across Veriss Creek.|Yasil Senerio, from a sworn testimony to the Imperial Investigation Committee on Lepusan Intelligence|<ref name="Beholder" />}}
The [[North Ridge Sector]] was a region on Freliq. It included a field located at its north section, and an abandoned rail line crossed Veriss Creek nearby.<ref name="Beholder" />

==Behind the scenes==
Freliq was first mentioned in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]'',<ref name="Creatures" /> including in the short companion narrative "[[In The Eye Of The Beholder]]" that was authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]].<ref name="Beholder" /> The book was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Creatures" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Freliq [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square U-9.<ref name="TEA" />
